## File: facebookresearch_anli/src/modeling/dummy_modeling_xlnet.py

Prompts

```
['build a PyTorch XLNet transformer model with relative positional attention and two-stream attention', 'create an XLNet language modeling head model for auto-regressive next token prediction', 'create an XLNet model with a sequence classification head for GLUE tasks', 'create an XLNet extractive QA model with beam search for SQuAD 2.0 tasks', 'load TensorFlow XLNet checkpoint weights into a PyTorch XLNet model', 'build a ResEncoder model with configurable LSTM hidden sizes and classifier layers for NLI classification', 'run the ResEncoder forward pass with input_ids and attention_mask to get logits and loss', 'initialize the ResEncoder embedding weights from a pretrained embedding matrix', 'build a BagOfWords model with average pooling over embeddings for NLI classification', 'run the BagOfWords forward pass with input_ids and attention_mask to get logits and loss']
```

Usage

```
{'build_xlnet_model': 'build a PyTorch XLNet transformer model with relative positional attention and two-stream attention', 'create_xlnet_lm_head': 'create an XLNet language modeling head model for auto-regressive next token prediction', 'create_xlnet_sequence_classification': 'create an XLNet model with a sequence classification head for GLUE tasks', 'create_xlnet_question_answering': 'create an XLNet extractive QA model with beam search for SQuAD 2.0 tasks', 'load_tf_weights_in_xlnet': 'load TensorFlow XLNet checkpoint weights into a PyTorch XLNet model'}
```
